projection.title: DynamoDB
projection.description: DynamoDB cockpit with tables, indexes, items, backups, TTL, tags, PartiQL, and guarded item/table operations.

fields.label: Endpoint override

fields.help: Optional prefix used to limit listed tables.

fields.help: Requires confirmation before write or destructive PartiQL operations.
